onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/properties/ground_friction.schema.json, set fr_c_preset to {{fr_c_preset}}]
Set ground friction preset to {{fr_c_preset}}: slippery=0.1, normal=0.5, grippy=1.5.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/properties/ground_friction.schema.json, set fr_c_combine_mode to {{fr_c_combine_mode}}]
Set KinematicForceController.frictionCombineMode to FrictionCombineMode.{{fr_c_combine_mode}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/properties/ground_friction.schema.json, set fr_t_static to {{fr_t_static}}]
Set KinematicForceController.staticFriction to {{fr_t_static}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/properties/ground_friction.schema.json, set fr_t_dynamic to {{fr_t_dynamic}}]
Set KinematicForceController.dynamicFriction to {{fr_t_dynamic}}.
